read_first: only referenced process/mechanics needed to resolve change
for a consequential site question, verify compact place state is sufficient before resolution
write_order: validate cause, authority, elapsed time and information limits
settle any causally relevant site operational module through the exact reached time
write separate personnel, force, stock, inventory or process owners only when their own authority actually changes
rebuild affected indexes and process consequences
invariants: Offscreen world state changes only through registered processes or resolved causal actions.
World ownership/control/resources are never inferred from labels or indexes.
Player knowledge remains separate from world truth.
Any world object capable of changing a consequential outcome must have sufficient authoritative state for that causal role or route to registered deeper authority before resolution.
Missing site detail is never silently treated as neutral, favorable, hostile or retroactively selected after a plan is revealed.
Static ambient locations establish ontology only and never imply mutable security, staff, supply, capacity, damage, access or readiness.
Strategic places persist only applicable causal modules; detailed personnel, units, stock, inventory and mechanics remain separate authorities referenced rather than duplicated.
